args.content:
library(forecast)

d <- read.csv("serie_mensual.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
d$fecha <- as.Date(d$fecha)
x <- ts(d$valor, start = c(year(d$fecha[1]), 1), frequency = 12)

m <- auto.arima(x)
f <- forecast(m, h = 12)

pred <- f$mean
last_date <- as.Date("2023-12-01")
next_dates <- seq(last_date, length.out = 13)[-1]

out <- data.frame(
  fecha     = format(next_dates, "%Y-%m-%d"),
  pronostico = round(pred, 2)
)

write.csv(out, "pronostico_r.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Pronostico de 12 meses:\n")
print(out)
cat("\nModelo:\n")
print(m)

args.content:
library(forecast)

d <- read.csv("serie_mensual.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
d$fecha <- as.Date(d$fecha)
x <- ts(d$valor, start = c(format(d$fecha[1], "%Y"), 1), frequency = 12)

m <- auto.arima(x)
f <- forecast(m, h = 12)

pred <- f$mean

last <- max(d$fecha)
y <- as.integer(format(last, "%Y"))
mth <- as.integer(format(last, "%m"))

out <- data.frame(fecha = character(12), pronostico = numeric(12), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (i in 1:12) {
  yy <- y
  mm <- mth + i
  while (mm > 12) { yy <- yy + 1; mm <- mm - 12 }
  out$fecha[i] <- sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", yy, mm)
  out$pronostico[i] <- round(pred[i], 2)
}

write.csv(out, "pronostico_r.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Pronostico de 12 meses:\n")
print(out)
cat("\nModelo:\n")
print(m)
